label: Own being: esse tantum versus real identity of esse and essence
resolution: OWN_BEING_1 (OwnBeingByQuiddity): the nature of x is being itself, esse tantum, compared by content. OWN_BEING_2 (EsseReallyIsEssence): x's esse is really identical with its essence. The unde route and R-act1 as derived here use OWN_BEING_1. De ente's stage (b) (argument 07b1fac4, result 860eae63, conclusion a576300f) is stated in Lean with OWN_BEING_2, while its source premises f13d1cdd and 38ed105c ('si autem ponatur aliqua res, quae sit esse tantum') speak of OWN_BEING_1. Read on OWN_BEING_2, 75b5b027, f13d1cdd and 38ed105c together amount to the bridge OWN_BEING_2 => OWN_BEING_1 (RealIdentityIsEsseTantum); a real-identity account of creatures (Suárez) denies that bridge: material creatures falsify 38ed105c and plausibly f13d1cdd on OWN_BEING_2, and 75b5b027 fails across species. CompositionStepUnbundled keeps the senses in separate conjuncts; no statement identifies them.
